justification: The published menu stops at 48 hours, which leaves the fleet no low-carbon firming beyond a couple of days; two classes extend it to one and two weeks and are offered on every solve so the cost ladder stays comparable.

basis: Least-squares fit to the published 10 24 and 48 hour points (S003)
justification: A line in duration separates power-related cost from reservoir cost per hour, so the extrapolation carries physical meaning; the fit is checked per financial year and a poor year is logged rather than used silently.

justification: Round-trip efficiency, fixed operating cost, lead time, economic life, locational cost factors and connection costs are taken unchanged from the 48-hour class; the published fixed operating cost is not monotonic in duration so any scaling would be invention.

basis: Reading of the GHD site assessment basis (S002 S003)
justification: A deeper reservoir at an assessed site is not an additional site; without one shared cap the duration classes would stack to several times the assessed potential.

basis: AEMO workbook notes quoted in code (S001)

justification: Total lead times are counted from the IASR publication year, so a class with a ten-year lead time is first buildable in 2035; no project-specific pipeline information is used.
